# mistershell_canary_alert_rule (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell canary_alert_rule by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_canary_alert_rule" "example" {
  name = "existing-canary-alert-rule"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `canary_ids` (Dynamic) Canary ids.
- `discard` (Boolean) Discard.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `event_codes` (Dynamic) Event codes.
- `forward` (Boolean) Forward.
- `location_ids` (Dynamic) Location ids.
- `log` (Boolean) Log.
- `notify` (Boolean) Notify.
- `position` (Number) Position.
- `service_types` (Dynamic) Service types.
- `src_cidrs` (Dynamic) Src cidrs.
